2099-3139-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-3139-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
2099-3139-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1116-4279-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.

728-2158-3249-3841--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-549-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-3197-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4460-6441.description:

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1409-2397-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1274-2541-6428.notablePrerequisites:
Magmakin Artillerist has lifelink.

1274-2541-6428.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1858-3075--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1947-3327-4613-6461.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-6461.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1253-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
1253-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Gyre Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Gyre Engineer
1253-5149-5200.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.
1253-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

238-413-1365-1477.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-413-1365-1477.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Gerrard enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2558-2981-5687-5690.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

444-5308.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
444-5308.description:
During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Confessor triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Confessor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 until no Confessor triggers remain.
Since you are still in the cleanup step, you must discard down to your maximum hand size again, repeating from step 1.
End the loop by declining to gain life with the remaining Confessor abilities.

You have at least three opponents.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2141-4499-4508-4793.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3} to exile Swarming Goblins and return it to the battlefield.
Swarming Goblins enters the battlefield, rolling a die and creating at least one 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Brazen Dwarf triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {3}.
Repeat.
